content: In a first step, we train Word2Vec on the target-domain corpus. In a second step, we take the intersection of $\mathbb {L}_\mathrm {LM}$ and $\mathbb {L}_\mathrm {W2V}$. In practice, the intersection mostly contains wordpieces from $\mathbb {L}_\mathrm {LM}$ that correspond to standalone words. It also contains single characters and other noise, however, we found that filtering them does not improve alignment quality. In a third step, we use the intersection to fit an unconstrained linear transformation $\mathbf {W} \in \mathbb {R}^{d_\mathrm {LM} \times d_\mathrm {W2V}}$ via least squares:
